meta.description: Meet the leadership behind Bremont Strategy's research and consulting practice — decades of combined market intelligence and strategy expertise.

hero.title: Our Team
hero.subtitle: The people behind Bremont Strategy's research and consulting practice.

members.name: Phillip Holland
members.title: Research Manager | Bremont Strategy
members.bio: Phillip Holland is a Research Manager at Bremont Strategy, bringing 10 years of industry expertise, including seven years of strategic leadership at the firm. As a distinguished SME in market intelligence, Phillip specializes in architecting robust research frameworks and leading high-value consulting engagements. His authoritative guidance enables organizations to turn changing market paradigms into long-term competitive advantages.

members.name: James Sifferman
members.title: Senior Consultant | Bremont Strategy
members.bio: James Sifferman is a Senior Consultant at Bremont Strategy with 7 years of market research and consulting experience, including 3 years at the firm. A recognized Subject Matter Expert (SME), James excels at transforming complex market dynamics into customized, high-impact strategic insights. His analytical rigor empowers clients to navigate industry shifts, identify emerging opportunities, and accelerate business growth.

members.name: Mark Anderson
members.title: Vice President of Business Development | Bremont Strategy
members.bio: Mark Anderson brings 12 years of market research leadership, including six years driving strategic growth at Bremont Strategy. A recognized SME, Mark shapes high-stakes commercial strategies and builds high-value global partnerships. His vision turns complex market disruptions into long-term competitive advantages, positioning clients at the forefront of industry evolution.
